_doc: Data for scripts/animation/ladder-smoke.mjs: the focused smoke of each SGD-ladder MVP slice. Lanes edit THIS file, not the script.
exists  {paths[]}  every path exists in the checkout (a stale pin fails at once).
route   {path, expect[], cookie?}  one GET against --origin; the status must be in expect (cookie: send --cookie-file).

tests   {cwd, files[], optional?, env?}  node --test over the named files (cwd is relative to the repo root; a file entry may be an object {file, optional} or a basename glob such as test/animation-*stream*.test.js).
A required file that is missing is a FAIL before anything runs (a stale list fails at once); an optional entry that matches nothing is a loud SKIP (ladder-smoke --strict turns it into a FAIL).
A run that executes 0 tests is a FAIL (node --test over a bad path exits 0).

script  {cmd, args[], optional?, needs?[]}  a command that must exit 0. optional: a missing script file is a SKIP. needs: variables from the command line (origin, sha, cookie) the item cannot run without: SKIP when absent.
bundle  {dir | origin:true, features[], expect?}  the built (dist-dev) or served (--origin) web bundle declares the client features (bundle-probe.mjs); expect 'absent' proves a recovery.
copy    {dir | origin:true, absent[], present[]}  regular expressions that must NOT / must match some chunk of the bundle (request-box copy).

browser {cmd}  a browser check: printed always, run only with --browser when the local stack answers; otherwise a loud SKIP that is NOT a pass (Claude does not run browser checks; CI fast-e2e or the owner does).
flags: the five MVP3 client features. golden: the fixture lane (f) writes. The args of the AN-20/AN-21 scripts are placeholders until those lanes publish their real flags.
